verdict.rationale: Data-residency and cross-border transfer verification is a fair question for a SaaS AML/compliance platform, so the axis applies. The pack only shows deployment models (cloud, private cloud, on-premise) and a production/sandbox environment split. Nothing documents a contracted processing region, data-residency commitments, or cross-border transfer handling, so deployment choice is only adjacent.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can verify the contracted processing region and cross-border handling for the chosen deployment
